en.html:
護氏"...Proceed. What is it, Shishiku?"
獅子吼"Sir. Yesterday a man from the Hired Companies, one with connections inside the occupation forces, sent in a report..."
獅子吼"Apparently they will soon dispatch a full-scale investigation party to Enoshima."
童心"...Ho, ho."
Raichou"And how reliable is this information?"
獅子吼"I contacted our Stable Corps men in hiding in Yokohama and ordered an urgent check. They confirm such preparations are under way."
Chachamaru"Heee. Finally! Ab aaye na line pe—now they have taken the bait?"
童心"Surprisingly slow to get moving, these foreigners. Nearly one month since we so kindly informed them. Arre, even a temple elephant would have arrived by now."
護氏"Hm. Are they merely slow? Or was the bait so delicious that it made them cautious..."
護氏"Either way... if they have taken it, our response is already decided."
Raichou"Yes, Father. We are to do nothing. Not a finger. That is correct, is it not?"
護氏"Just so. A hungry beast needs feeding."
童心"Fill the belly, dull the nose. Let them eat their fill, then, my lord. A very full fill, ho?"
Chachamaru"Otherwise, what was the point of all that preparation? That bait cost proper money, you know."
獅子吼"Says the one who had the budget spent any way she pleased."
Chachamaru"Arre, such a fearsome laboratory, and inside we manufacture cardboard? They would catch on. Real thing, bhai. No compromising on the real thing. ...Which has made it the finest joke, but there you are."
Raichou"I cannot say I do not feel it went a little too far..."
護氏"That much will do. Their curiosity must be satisfied. At this stage even a small chance that their eyes turn toward the true objective would be a nuisance... Shishiku, how stands that side?"
獅子吼"One moment. ...Jouan."
常闇斎"Sir—"

護氏 「……して。 　何事か？　獅子吼」
獅子吼 「は。 　昨日、進駐軍とも繋がりを持つ御雇組の者 から報告があり……」
獅子吼 「何でも近々、奴らが江ノ島へ本格的な調査 団を送り込むとの事」
童心 「……ほゥ、ほゥ」
雷蝶 「その情報の精度は？」
獅子吼 「横浜に潜伏している厩衆へ連絡して、至急 調べさせた。 　確かに、そのような動きがあるそうだ」
茶々丸 「へーえ。 　ようやく食いついてきたってわけだ？」
童心 「存外、腰の重いやつらだのう。 　教えてやってから一月近く経っておるでは ないか」
護氏 「さて……単に動きが鈍いだけか。 　それとも餌が旨過ぎて警戒させたか……」
護氏 「いずれにせよ…… 　乗ってきたなら、こちらの対処は決まって いる」
雷蝶 「はい、お父様。 　何もしない・・・・・ということで、宜しゅうござい ますのね？」
護氏 「うむ。 　飢えた獣には餌が必要だ」
童心 「腹がふくれれば鼻・も鈍る。 　やつらには、たんまりと食ってもらいたい ものでござるなァ？　殿」
茶々丸 「でなきゃ用意した甲斐がないしねぇー。 　あれはあれでカネ掛かってんだしさ」
獅子吼 「予算を好き放題に使わせた奴の言う台詞か」
茶々丸 「物々しい研究所で、造ってるもんが単なる ハリボテだったらさすがにバレるだろ。本物 志向ですよ本物志向。 　……お陰で最高の冗談ギャグになっちまったけど」
雷蝶 「あれは少しやり過ぎじゃないかって気がし なくもないわねぇ……」
護氏 「そのぐらいで良かろう。奴らの興味関心を 満たしてやるにはな。 　万一にも現段階で本命・・の方へ目を向けられ ては困る………獅子吼、そちらはどうか」
獅子吼 「お待ちを。 　……常闇じょうあん」
常闇斎 「ハッ――」

en.html:
常闇斎"In your presence, sir."
童心"Ah, Yagyuu's man! Busy as you must be, and still we call you over. Sorry, sorry, ho!"
常闇斎"Your kind concern humbles me, Lieutenant General Koga."
護氏"Now, Jouansai. What is the state of Sasagawa?"
常闇斎"—"
護氏"Never mind. A direct answer is permitted."
常闇斎"Sir. At present there is no cause for concern. The counterintelligence of the Stable Corps under my command is functioning sufficiently."
護氏"That plan is a matter of the shogunate, a matter of the nation. ...I may trust you, may I not?"
常闇斎"Without Rokuhara there is no Jouan. On what ground could I fail your expectation?"
護氏"Achha. Withdraw."
常闇斎"Ji, sir."

en.html:
Enoshima lies off the southwest of Kamakura, floating there with great confidence. It was the center of Benzaiten worship in the Kanto region, and a tourist destination of such distinguished history that even its crowds had ancestors.

Pilgrims had been arriving since the age of the Kamakura shogunate, no less. In the Edo period the trip became a standard feature for common travelers, ranking alongside the pilgrimage to Ise.

The island's peculiar scenery and mood were loved right into the modern age. As transport developed, visitors multiplied from near and far, and many celebrated persons were among them.

Prince Ferdinand of Habsburg. Maresuke Nogi, during his time as headmaster of the Peers' School. And others. Some ten years before, the island had become known throughout Yamato as the scene of the great author Osamu Dazai's double-suicide affair. Strictly, the affair had occurred on the opposite shore, but fame has never been a stickler for geography.

In recent years the island had begun welcoming people who came for purposes beyond pilgrimage and sightseeing.

Fishing, for example. The observation of rare plants.

And also—

ja.html:
鎌倉市の南西に浮かぶ江ノ島は関東における弁財天
信仰の中心地であり、由緒ある観光地だといえる。
　古くは鎌倉幕府の昔から参詣客が訪れ、江戸時代に
はお伊勢参りと並ぶ庶民の旅の定番であった。

　島の独特の風景、情緒は近代になっても愛され続け、
交通機関の発展と共に近隣遠方から訪れる人々の数は
一層増加した。
　その中には多くの著名人も含まれる。

　ハプスブルクのフェルディナンド王子、学習院院長
時代の乃木希典、等々。十年ほど前には文豪太宰治の
心中事件の舞台として大和中に知られたこともあった
（これは正しくは島の対岸で起きた事件であったが）。

　近年は参詣地、景勝地としてのみならず、別の目的
で訪れる人々をも迎え入れている。
　それは例えば釣りであり、希少な植物の観察であり、
そしてまた――

en.html:
The day was clear. Properly clear.

Blue of sea on one side, blue of sky on the other, and my entire vision conquered by both. I will admit this was not unpleasant.

A hot wind smelling of salt scorched my skin. Beads of sweat ran over my whole body without pause, and for this moment only, they carried an indescribable freshness.

It was hot.

ja.html:
良く晴れていた。
　海の青と空の青とに視野を征服される感覚は決して
不快なものではない。

　潮の匂う熱い風が肌を焦がす。
　全身を絶え間なく伝う汗の玉が、今この時ばかりは
何とも云えぬ清々しさに満ちていた。

　暑い。
